title: Dose Input
description: Prevents ten-fold medication errors by flagging the ISMP error-prone dose designations as they're typed (trailing zeros like 1.0 mg read as 10 mg, a missing leading zero, U and IU, µg, cc, a unit flush against the number, uncommaed big numbers), rewriting the dose safely in one tap, offering the likely meant value when a dose is 10× outside the drug's usual range (mg typed for mcg, a slipped decimal), and spelling it back in words.
